# function: ssm_contacts_contactchannel

Builds the ARN for `ssm-contacts` `contactchannel`:

```
arn:${Partition}:ssm-contacts:${Region}:${Account}:contactchannel/${ContactAlias}/${ContactChannelId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:ssm-contacts:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:contactchannel/contact-alias/contact-channel-id
output "ssm_contacts_contactchannel" {
  value = provider::arn::ssm_contacts_contactchannel("contact-alias", "contact-channel-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
ssm_contacts_contactchannel(contact_alias string, contact_channel_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `contact_alias` (String) Value for `${ContactAlias}` in the ARN template.
1. `contact_channel_id` (String) Value for `${ContactChannelId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
